Matiks

Who they are

Matiks is one of the fastest-growing competitive brain-training apps (3.5M+ users worldwide) — speed/mental-math and timed puzzle challenges (e.g. sudoku) with global leaderboards and ranks, turning brain training into a competitive game.

What they want

  • UGC Creator Program — 150 short-form videos (15–30s), ~3/day over ~10 weeks; $1000 base + view bonuses ($100@100k → $1,000@1M views); scripts provided with room for your own creative spin.
  • Distribution: the same videos go across Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, posted on Matiks-owned brand accounts (not the creator's).
  • Content angle: relatable / POV brain-training flex — e.g. 'how it feels solving expert sudoku under 1 min (rank 1 on Matiks btw)'; make competitive brain-training look fun + addictive.
  • Study below: what top brain-training / puzzle / mental-math short-form looks like (competitors + keyword content) to model the 150-video output.
